verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks as a push mechanism that replaces polling for asynchronous status changes. Its risk docs state that risk information, such as case-management routing and triggered risk rules, can be included in those webhooks, so programmatic consumers can receive risk events. missing for 10: explicit documentation of registering endpoints and selecting event types, delivery guarantees/signature verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process
You can include risk information, such as whether a payment was sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered in these webhooks, as well as in the payment response.
